lena_devex: Running into a weird case with the Python SDK async client. client.generate(...) raises an APIError but the payload is application/problem+json and we end up with JSONDecodeError in the exception code.

dan_backend: ugh. can you paste the stack and the response headers?

lena_devex: stack: 
```
File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/sdk/async_client.py", line 214, in _handle_response
    data = await resp.json()  # crashes on invalid json
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/aiohttp/client_reqrep.py", line 1296, in json
    raise ContentTypeError
aiohttp.ContentTypeError: 0, message='Attempt to decode JSON with unexpected mimetype'
```
headers: `{'content-type': 'application/problem+json; charset=utf-8', 'x-request-id': 'req_abc123'}`

sophie_sdk: This is why we can't rely on resp.json() w/o checking content-type. For RFC7807 the body is JSON but some clients set a variant media type and aiohttp is strict.

alex_infra: We should probably fall back to resp.text() when .json() raises, and then try json.loads on the text to preserve the original error payload. Also capture raw_text on the exception object.

lena_devex: agree. right now APIError only has .message and .status. no .raw_body or .payload. I had to wrap it manually in my app.

dan_backend: temporary patch idea: in async_client._handle_response: 
```py
try:
    payload = await resp.json()
except Exception:
    text = await resp.text()
    try:
        payload = json.loads(text)
    except Exception:
        payload = None
# attach payload and raw_text to APIError
raise APIError(status=resp.status, payload=payload, raw_text=text)
```

sophie_sdk: long-term we should: 1) expose typed exceptions (RedwoodHTTPError, RedwoodValidationError) 2) include `.payload: Optional[Dict[string, Any]]` and `.raw_text: Optional[string]` on them 3) mark `.is_retryable` for 5xx / rate-limit.

alex_infra: +1. Also consider a helper `parse_problem_details(body: str) -> ProblemDetails` that tries multiple content-types and maps `title`, `detail`, `invalid_params` to a structured object. We could add typing stub so users get autocomplete.

lena_devex: is there an open ticket for "exception payload + raw_text + typed exceptions"? i searched but didn't find a single canonical issue.

dan_backend: not yet. I'll open a GH issue and link it here. short-term fix: i can push a minimal patch that does the resp.text fallback and includes raw_text in APIError. want it in 0.23.1?

sophie_sdk: yes patch it. also please include a changelog note and a small unit test that simulates application/problem+json with weird mime.

lena_devex: thanks. can you also add a tiny example in docs showing how to inspect `exc.payload` vs `exc.raw_text` when validating model input fails? new users keep doing `str(e)` and then logging nothing useful.

dan_backend: will do. opening issue now.

deploy-bot: CI: build/pytest-3 passed for branch fix/async-error-fallback (pipeline #4321) :white_check_mark:

lena_devex: awesome, thanks everyone. this will unblock a few customers who hit 422 problem-json from upstream validators. :rocket:
